decision.finding: The pinned test says source_evidence contains rowB source_record_id, but the actual handoff groups observations by (family, source, role); row identity is nested under source_evidence[*].clock_provenance.effective/availability/observed.source_record_id, not a top-level source_evidence[*].source_record_id. A direct top-level assertion would falsely fail. Use a unique rowB source and assert the nested provenance plus observation_count and archive_records_loaded; compare complete persisted handoff after B and after A, not just equal as_of_ms or three-file timestamps.
runnable_no_network_contract: At exact public SHA in disposable checkout, create unique valid PIT BTC ETF FlowObservation rowB (family=etf, metric=net_flow_usd, source=fixture_two_writer, source_record_id=rowB, effective/available/observed <= identical T) but do not append yet; A starts with empty observations.jsonl and run_once(local_dir=tmp_path,network=False,as_of_ms=T).

Patch runner.atomic_write_json INSIDE A child only: block via bounded multiprocessing Event just before A replaces anata_latest.json; A has already built its empty handoff. Spawn workers using a top-level process target, bounded join, finally release and terminate on timeout; never patch B.

After A_ready append rowB once using append_observations, then B run_once same local_dir/network=False/T to completion. Assert B archive_records_loaded=1; B anata_output source_evidence entry for (etf,fixture_two_writer,scoring) has observation_count=1 and clock_provenance.effective.source_record_id=rowB; assert A anata_output source_evidence lacks this entry.

Before A release, on-disk anata_latest.json equals B anata_output. Release A; assert both exitcodes zero and final on-disk anata_latest.json still equals B (or causally newer) and retains nested rowB provenance. Assert archive exactly one row; no duplicate or orphan temp files. Source-derived baseline likely violates final stale-retention assertion; record observed result, never claim unrun failure.

Separate positive control: sequential run C at T with no archive mutation must preserve rowB; do not conflate unrelated latest.json/audit_latest.json transactional consistency with single-handoff causal ordering. Run targeted then full tests, capture SHA/overlay hash/exit codes/logs/non-skipped counts.
